items.title: Arrive Taipei
items.pace: Transfer in and keep the first night light
items.tldr: Airport MRT, hotel, easy neighborhood dinner.
items.body: Use Airport MRT into Taipei and avoid scheduling a ticketed anchor on arrival night.

items.title: CKS Memorial + Nanjichang
items.pace: History by day, food market at night
items.tldr: CKS Memorial, unhurried central Taipei, then the Pass B night-market pick.
items.body: Visit Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall with the museum's democratic-transition context in mind. In the evening, eat at Nanjichang rather than defaulting to Shilin: independent recent firsthand sources support the more local-feeling, food-first fit.

items.title: National Palace Museum
items.pace: One major museum, no museum marathon
items.tldr: National Palace Museum, then a lighter afternoon.
items.body: Give the National Palace Museum the morning and early afternoon. Regular admission is {{fact:npm-adult}}.

items.title: Taipei 101 + Xinyi
items.tldr: Keep the iconic first-trip landmark without overpacking the district.
items.body: Taipei 101 Observatory is open 10:00–21:00 and regular admission is {{fact:taipei101-adult}}.

items.title: Jiufen early
items.pace: Beat peak crowds, then linger over tea
items.tldr: Go early for quieter streets; Yu Zai Fan Shu if current hours work.
items.body: Make Jiufen an early day: two independent recent firsthand sources converge on morning as materially quieter before peak traffic. Use Yu Zai Fan Shu as the quieter-teahouse lead, but confirm its hours rather than inheriting a platform listing.
constraints: No claim that Jiufen hosts a November lantern-release event

items.title: Shifen waterfall + lantern release
items.tldr: Waterfall before final entry, then an ordinary Shifen lantern release.
items.body: Shifen Waterfall runs 09:00–17:00 in November with final entry 16:30. Afterward, use Shifen Old Street's ordinary sky-lantern shops for the corrected anchor experience. This is not the Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival, whose official 2026 dates were Feb 27 and Mar 3.
constraints: Recheck TRA/bus service close to travel; no future timetable was guessed

items.title: Open Taipei + logy
items.pace: Leave recovery room, then the splurge dinner
items.tldr: An intentionally open day capped by the reservation-sensitive tasting menu.
items.body: Keep daytime flexible. Book logy when its 30-day window opens and obey its 3-day cancellation deadline.
constraints: logy is closed Mondays on the currently posted schedule — move the splurge if these dates hold

items.title: Departure
items.tldr: Leave the last day flexible around the unconfirmed SFO itinerary.
items.body: SFO is still an intake assumption, so no flight-time-specific plan is invented.
